dryRun: gh workflow run delegate-eval-run.yml --ref main -f mode=dry-run -f branch={branch} -f run_id={run_id}
inner: gh workflow run delegate-eval-run.yml --ref main -f mode=inner -f branch={branch} -f cases={cases} -f run_id={run_id} -f budget_usd={budget_usd}
tune: gh workflow run delegate-eval-run.yml --ref main -f mode=tune -f branch={branch} -f targets={cases} -f run_id={run_id} -f budget_usd={budget_usd}
gate: gh workflow run delegate-eval-run.yml --ref main -f mode=gate -f branch={branch} -f targets={cases} -f run_id={run_id} -f budget_usd={budget_usd}

artifacts.gate: gate.json: pass, regressions, targetsMissed, costRatio, costOver, cases (tune only), holdout {total, passed, regressions}
